about.title: A clinic patients keep coming back to
paragraphs: Daily Dentals is on the first floor of Silver City Plaza in G-11 Markaz, above Soneri Bank. It is a small clinic, and that is the point — appointments are unrushed and you see the same dentist each time.

Read through our reviews and the same words come up: clean, cooperative, and explained clearly. Several patients have been through a full year of monthly orthodontic appointments with us and still describe the experience as consistently good.

highlights.title: Clean and well-organised

highlights.title: Nothing happens without an explanation

highlights.title: A cooperative team
highlights.description: Patients describe the staff as polite and thoughtful about the concerns they raise.

highlights.title: Comfortable treatment

items.question: Where exactly is the clinic?
items.answer: Office #2, first floor, Silver City Plaza, G-11 Markaz, Islamabad — directly above Soneri Bank. Use the 'Get directions' link on this page and it will take you to the entrance.

items.question: How do I book an appointment?
items.answer: The quickest way is WhatsApp — send us a message with what you need and a rough time that suits you, and we'll confirm. You can also call the clinic directly on 0300 0752362.

items.question: Do you treat braces cases from start to finish?
items.answer: Yes. Orthodontic treatment runs with monthly adjustment appointments, and Dr. Maliha explains what has changed and what comes next at each one.

items.question: Will the treatment hurt?
items.answer: Our reviews describe treatment here as efficient and painless more often than any other phrase. Tell us if you are anxious when you book and we will take extra time to talk you through it first.

items.question: What does a first visit involve?
items.answer: An examination and a straightforward conversation about what, if anything, needs doing — including the option of doing nothing yet. Nothing is started without explaining it to you first.
